_README: Prop-firm rule profiles for the Combine simulator. VERIFY every number against Topstep's CURRENT rules before relying on it — prop-firm rules change and vary by account size and program (Trading Combine vs Express Funded vs Live Funded). These are the widely-known Trading Combine values and are provided as a starting point, NOT as authoritative current terms. Edit freely; the simulator reads this file.

_notes.max_loss_limit: TRAILING maximum loss (a.k.a. trailing drawdown). In the real Combine it trails your highest intraday equity INCLUDING open profit, and typically stops trailing once it reaches your starting balance. This simulator trails on realized (closed-trade) equity, which is slightly MORE LENIENT than the real thing — treat a pass here as necessary, not sufficient.
_notes.daily_loss_limit: Max loss allowed in a single calendar trading day.
_notes.on_daily_loss: 'lockout' = stop trading for the rest of that day; 'fail' = end the Combine. Verify which applies to your program.
_notes.consistency_pct: Payout/consistency rule: no single day may exceed this fraction of total profit. Set null to disable for a pure pass check.
_notes.min_trading_days: Minimum number of distinct days with at least one trade.

topstep_50k.name: Topstep Trading Combine 50K (One Rule)
topstep_50k._note: Verified from user's dashboard.topstep.com screenshots (Jul 2026): One-Rule model. Max contracts 5 mini / 50 micro. Daily Loss Limit $1,000 is Responsible-Trading lockout, not a fail. Payout paths: Standard (5x $150 winning days) or Consistency (>=3 days, best day <=40% of profit); the 50% consistency_pct below is the combine consistency target.
